summary: Wired Datasette startup into the ASGI lifespan. Added Datasette._startup_sequence(), an idempotent lock-guarded entry point that runs the immutable-database table_counts precompute (tracked by new _setup_db_done) then invoke_startup(), plus a new _startup_lock. Datasette.app() now passes _startup_sequence to AsgiLifespan (on_startup) and AsgiRunOnFirstRequest, replacing the local setup_db. AsgiLifespan catches startup/shutdown exceptions and reports lifespan.startup.failed/shutdown.failed. AsgiRunOnFirstRequest gained an asyncio.Lock, passes lifespan scopes straight through, and sets _started only after hooks complete. cli.py serve now awaits _startup_sequence(). Checks: 157 passed, 4 skipped.
concerns: _setup_db_done is set True even if a database's table_counts raises mid-loop; a retry would then skip the precompute (invoke_startup would still run).
AsgiLifespan returns after startup.failed without waiting for shutdown; confirm that matches real server expectations.
AsgiRunOnFirstRequest takes the lock on every non-started request; verify no deadlock if a startup hook itself re-enters the app.
